visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at the storefront of a tea shop named 'TP TEA' (茶湯會). Two women stand in the foreground; one wears a light green shirt and gray shorts, while the other is in a black t-shirt and beige trousers. A staff member in a black uniform and red cap is visible behind the counter. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the wooden frames of the shop and a red decorative lantern. (2) The camera transitions to an extreme close-up of a thick, light brown milk tea liquid being poured from a white plastic container into a white paper cup. The liquid is frothy with small bubbles on the surface. The background is a clean, metallic kitchen surface. (3) Two branded paper cups are held up toward the camera. The cups feature a collaboration design with 'tigerair' and 'TP TEA,' showing a cartoon tiger mascot looking through airplane window graphics against an orange and white background. The person's hands are visible holding the cups against the backdrop of the shop interior. (4) The camera captures the drink preparation process. A dark amber tea is poured into a transparent blender jar, followed by a scoop of thick yellow fruit jam. Then, a creamy beige liquid is strained through a light green plastic sieve into a cup already containing ice cubes. (5) A white paper cup filled with small, golden-brown egg pancakes shaped like miniature tea cups is displayed on a wooden table. A hand picks up one pancake and breaks it open in three separate shots to reveal different fillings: a solid yellow custard-like center, a red bean paste filling, and a dark black sesame filling. (6) The final shot returns to the storefront, showing the staff member working at the register. The camera slowly zooms out, revealing more of the shop's menu boards and the clean, modern architectural lines of the outdoor mall or street area.
